coverage.title: Our coverage
coverage.subtitle: We operate in 8 countries with regular routes throughout Europe

questions.question: What are the usual delivery times?
questions.answer: Delivery times vary depending on distance and destination. For national routes, between 24-48 hours. For international routes in Europe, between 3-5 business days. We also offer express service with deliveries in less than 24 hours.

questions.question: Can I track my shipment in real time?
questions.answer: Yes, all our customers have access to a personalized panel where they can monitor the exact location of their shipment in real time, see the delivery status and receive automatic notifications.

questions.question: What type of cargo do you transport?
questions.answer: We transport all types of general cargo, from pallets and boxes to industrial machinery. We have specialized vehicles for refrigerated loads, fragile cargo and large volume loads. Consult with our team for specific cases.

questions.question: How do I request a quote?
questions.answer: You can request a no-obligation quote through our online form, by calling +34 900 000 000 or writing to hola@truckwave.com. We will respond in less than 2 hours with a detailed quote.

questions.question: What happens if there is an incident during transport?
questions.answer: We have cargo insurance that covers any incident. Our customer service team is available 24/7 to handle any problem. In addition, you will receive immediate notifications in case of any eventuality.

about.title: Trusted transportation from Mercabarna
about.subtitle: Family-owned transportation company with over 15 years moving fresh produce with commitment, punctuality and close service.
about.historyTitle: A story of effort and commitment
about.historyText1: This company was born from the effort of a single person who decided to start a business in the transportation sector at Mercabarna. With dedication, responsibility and many hours on the road, it grew step by step.
about.historyText2: Today, the company has three trucks and the second generation at the helm, maintaining the same values from day one: punctuality, close service and commitment to each client.
about.historyText3: We work every day to ensure your cargo arrives on time and in perfect condition.
